title: hive-pool transition: request body
description: Moves one item between queued, in-flight, done and archived under the transition rules of spec/pool.md, the return from in-flight to queued of an item with no open generation included. A transition to done on a Target, or on a Prey that has a Hunt beneath it, is refused with pool.derived_state: their landing is derived. A failed transition is reported as failed, never as done.

evidence.description: For done: the Harvest, report or landing the completion rests on, added to the item's links.

note.description: A line appended to the body.

reason.description: For archived, or for a reopen: why.

at.description: The closing time to record for done, where the caller knows it; otherwise the command's clock.
